mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.knowledge_id AS knowledgeId, d.doc_title AS docTitle, d.doc_source_type AS docSourceType, d.file_url AS fileUrl, d.file_size AS fileSize, d.file_suffix AS fileSuffix, d.slice_mode AS sliceMode, d.recall_count AS recallCount, d.status, d.create_time AS createTime FROM bedrock_ai_knowledge_doc d WHERE d.id = #{id} AND d.is_deleted = 0
